messages:
maia: quick Q — running into reassembly failures in the SDK when function-call `arguments` are large and split across streaming deltas. should clients just concat text until final event, or is there a contract we missed? :thinking:

devon: short answer: clients should concat raw text pieces for `arguments` and parse once the call finishes, but we didn't define explicit chunk metadata. this causes ambiguity for mid-stream function updates and edgecases with partial utf-8 or embedded JSON braces.

jules: can you paste an example of the sequence that broke the SDK? cc @kai

maia: sure, simplified stream we observed (each line is one SSE/data delta):

```
data: {"delta":{"name":"update_user","arguments":"{\"id\": \"u1\", \"attrs\": {\"bio\": \""}}
data: {"delta":{"arguments":"lorem ipsum \n with commas and \"quotes\" ..."}}
data: {"delta":{"arguments":"\", \"flag\": true}"}, "finish_reason":"function_call"}
```
The SDK attempted to parse after the second chunk because of internal heuristics and choked on the unclosed JSON; we then saw exceptions rather than buffering.

kai: two problems here: (1) streaming currently has no explicit ordering/last-bit signal for multi-chunk fields, so heuristics vary by SDK; (2) some clients assume each delta payload is valid JSON on its own. possible fixes: add explicit chunk meta (index/is_last) OR add a small 'stream_start' event describing encoding and that certain fields are chunked. prefer minimal nonbreaking change: optional chunk metadata.

devon: server-side we can emit optional fields on the delta envelope: `chunk_index` (int) and `more_coming` (bool). default behavior for older clients unchanged. that would be shipped behind a feature-flag to start.

maia: would older SDKs ignore those new fields fine? we need to avoid breaking parsing logic in languages that use strict JSON mapping.

jules: yeah, older SDKs should ignore unknown keys. but we also need a way to signal stream-wide encoding (e.g., whether arguments are raw string fragments or already json-escaped). suggestion: emit an initial meta event: `{\"meta\":\"stream_start\",\"stream_id\":\"<uuid>\",\"reassembly_version\":\"v2\",\"encoding\":\"json-escaped\"}`. then deltas include `chunk_index` and `is_last`. SDKs that don't look at stream_start will still concatenate text and should keep working.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: heads-up — opt-in feature flag `streaming_reassembly_v2` will be available in the eng-runtime deploy scheduled for tomorrow 06:00 UTC. will gate behind tenant flag. :rocket:

kai: i can draft the API doc changes and a small helper `parse_streamed_arguments(stream_events)` that handles both v1 (concat until finish) and v2 (use chunk_index + is_last). will add tests for utf-8 boundary and newline cases.

maia: thanks — i'll write a tiny RFC with sample SSE sequences, SDK migration tips, and testcases. can @devon @kai review when i post? :+1:

devon: yup, will review. also want a compatibility test in the runtime integration suite that simulates interleaved tool deltas.

jules: adding this to the contract board, and tagging infra for load tests. good sync, thanks all.
